title: Gold Bar Apollo Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The Gold Bar Apollo 20K is a revolutionary prefilled pod kit designed for vapers who value convenience, flavour, longevity and versatility in one compact device. With an impressive potential for up to 4000 puffs (depending upon personal usage) , the Apollo 20K Pod Kit features a powerful 1000mAh rechargeable battery that can keep you vaping all day with minimal recharging. Each Apollo 20K kit includes a 5ml prefilled pod coupled with an additional 2ml refill tank. This smart configuration provides extended use without the fuss of constant refilling or carrying spare e-liquid bottles. Simply pop in the pod, enjoy smooth, satisfying draws on some of Gold Bar’s bestselling flavours, and refill from the 5ml backup pod as needed to keep the flavour fresh and consistent. A child-resistant cap adds a welcome layer of extra security to your device. Gold Bar's Apollo 20K range offers a variety of irresistible flavours, allowing you to pick the option that best suits your taste. Each pod contains Hyper Mesh Coil technology for an ideal balance of throat hit, vapour production, and flavour intensity, making it a versatile choice for both new and seasoned vapers alike. Flavours Available: Choose from a wide range of popular Gold Bar flavours crafted to suit every taste, from vibrant fruits to refreshing mint blends all 20mg: Blue Raspberry: A bold, tangy Blue Raspberry flavour for a super-sweet and satisfying vape. Cherry Fizz: Sweet Cherry meets fizzy Soda notes for a timeless, refreshing taste. Lemon & Lime: A zesty blend of Lemon and Lime for a classic, citrusy experience. Pineapple Ice: Tropical Pineapple with a cool, icy exhale for a refreshing finish. Pineapple Watermelon Lemonade: Juicy Pineapple and Watermelon complemented by fizzy Lemonade. Pink Burst : A burst of sweet, smooth Strawberry balanced with a hint of crisp Apple. Sour Apple: A crisp, tangy Apple flavour with just the right amount of sourness. Spearmint: Cool, smooth and delicately floral Spearmint, for a frosty, refreshing vape. Summer Berries: A blend of ripe, juicy Berries for a sweet and tangy taste that lingers. Watermelon Ice: Fresh, juicy Watermelon with a crisp, refreshing icy exhale. Simply select your preferred flavour to personalise your experience with the Gold Bar Apollo 20K Prefilled Pod Kit. Replenish your Gold Bar Apollo Kit with our 2ml replaceable pods, available separately in packs of two, or opt for the convenient combo pack that includes a 2ml pod with an additional 5ml refill container. Available in a variety of bestselling Gold Bar flavours, these replacement options give you the flexibility to switch up flavours whenever the mood strikes.
